The '''Citrus County Detention Facility''' is a privately operated jail located in [[Lecanto, Florida|Lecanto]], [[Citrus County, Florida]], run by the [[Corrections Corporation of America]] to house inmates for multiple jurisdictions:  the county, the [[United States Virgin Islands Department of Justice]], and the [[U.S. Marshals Service]].  The facility houses a maximum of 760 prisoners, both male and female, at mixed security levels.<ref>{{cite web|title=Citrus County Detention Facility|url=http://www.cca.com/facilities/citrus-county-detention-facility|website=Corrections Corporation of America|accessdate=11 September 2016}}</ref>
